subject: [RFC PATCH 01/18] mm: free PG_rcu_free folios only after an RCU grace period

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch introduces a new page flag called PG_rcu_free to allow folios to be freed only after an RCU (Read-Copy Update) grace period. This is necessary because without a reference, a folio can be freed while still being read by another CPU, leading to memory reuse issues. The patch adds support for this flag in various kernel files and introduces a new workqueue to handle the freeing of folios with this flag. It also includes a new counter in /proc/vmstat to track deferred pages. This patch is part of a larger series that aims to improve page management and reduce memory contention on large machines.
